name: Devin
description: Devin is an AI software engineer that automates coding workflows, manages sessions, and integrates via REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

evidence.claim: All API credentials use the cog_ prefix format and include token in the Authorization header.
The Devin API is organized into Organization and Enterprise scopes with base URLs like https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/*.
Devin provides official Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.

notes: Devin provides documented REST APIs using service user API keys (cog_ prefix) and Personal Access Tokens, as well as an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation.
